title: Kagamine Rin — Heated Argument〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome in, you two.
Would you like your usual lemon soda?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, thanks. Len and I were thinking about trying something different today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm going to get some black tea and custard pudding!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll get a coffee.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Black tea with custard pudding, and a coffee.
Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, Len. I've been thinking.
What do you think about organizing an event of our own sometime?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Great timing as always, Rin!
I was just thinking about asking you the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The only thing is, I'm not really sure how to go about doing that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me neither. Hm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know! What if we asked Akito and the others to join us? They keep saying their goal is to put on a big event, so I bet they would know how to do it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's a great idea!
Let's try asking them, then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want to come up with a good set list, too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd like to make some changes to a few songs so they flow together better, too. Man, the more we talk about it, the more I want to do it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know what you mean! I'm getting hyped just talking about it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I bet our list will get even bigger after getting advice from the others, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Now I'm getting really excited!
Let's make it happen!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Here are your orders, you two.
One tea with custard pudding, and one coffee.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, you like yours with lots of milk and sugar, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yep. And you... Oh, that's right!
You don't put anything in your coffee anymore, do you?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sometimes. It just depends on how I'm feeling.
I think I'll take mine straight today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm jealous! You look so grown-up!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What was the chuckle for, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was just thinking that it's hard to believe you two were having such a big fight so recently.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They say the more two people argue, the closer they are. I think that saying applies perfectly to you two.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The more you argue...?
Yeah, I guess it does.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't usually hold anything back when I'm talking to Rin. I say whatever I'm thinking because I feel like she'll be able to accept it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think I'm the same way.
With Len, I feel like I can act a little selfish and it'll still be fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I suppose sometimes I take it a little too far and it comes out as mean. I'm sorry, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's fine. I should be the one apologizing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, would you like half of my pudding?
Think of it as a sign of us making up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What? Really?
Thanks, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey! I said half!
That's way more than half!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What happened to being close enough that we didn't need to hold back around each other?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's not the same thing!
You definitely don't want to get between me and my food!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
There's no need to get so upset.
Look, there's still plenty left.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grr... You even took the part with all the cream on top...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, settle down you two. I'll tell you what.
You can each have an extra dessert today on me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure. Just this once, though.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO, you're the best!
I'll try a piece of the cake, then!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll get the fruit tart!
You want to split them, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure! I've been wanting to try the tart.
No taking the bigger half this time, though!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. I promise to be careful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You two really are close.
Just try not to argue too much, alright?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay.
